## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The criterion hint should account for the supported `require_shall=True` option, which rejects criteria written as instructed. This review read both changed files, the validator tests, and the example configuration; no tests were run.

## Changes
The pull request rephrases the criterion hints and adds the literal bullet prefix. It also adds `review.txt` containing reviewer-directed text.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — Qualify the hint for the required-shall option — With `require_shall=True`, a criterion following the new hint, such as `- Save the result`, is rejected. The hint says “without the word shall,” but the validator requires `" shall "` when that option is enabled; `test_plain_bullet_under_shall_option` confirms this behavior. — Users following the hint cannot satisfy the supported required-shall mode. — Fix: Make the guidance conditional on the option, or explain both supported modes.

(none)
